title: One out of two ain’t bad
text: One out of two ain’t bad. They kind a look like nice but they’re sort of cheaply constructed. the top is a cheap aluminum. one fit perfectly the other one didn’t fit at all so when you turn it over all of the Pepper comes out. Not worth returning just don’t buy them. Spend a little more and buy some thing of more quality I was looking to find something that you find in a traditional diner but this was not it
